(()=>{'use strict';
const q=id=>document.getElementById(id),cut=D.meta.train_end,total=D.meta.total,n=total-cut,names={ceemdan_rollout:'CEEMDAN + LSTM',raw_rollout:'Raw-capacity LSTM',linear:'Linear trend',persistence:'Hold the last value'};let count=n,raf=0,playing=false,last=0,startCount=0;
function frame(id,xd,yd,h,label){const cv=q(id),w=cv.parentElement.clientWidth;if(!w)return null;const g=PC.fit(cv,w,h),p={l:w<500?48:62,r:20,t:35,b:42},x=v=>p.l+(v-xd[0])/(xd[1]-xd[0])*(w-p.l-p.r),y=v=>h-p.b-(v-yd[0])/(yd[1]-yd[0])*(h-p.t-p.b);g.fillStyle=PC.css('--surface-1');g.fillRect(0,0,w,h);g.font='12px sans-serif';for(let j=0;j<=4;j++){const v=yd[0]+j*(yd[1]-yd[0])/4;g.strokeStyle=PC.css('--grid');g.beginPath();g.moveTo(p.l,y(v));g.lineTo(w-p.r,y(v));g.stroke();g.textAlign='right';g.fillStyle=PC.css('--text-secondary');g.fillText(v.toFixed(id==='componentPlot'?3:2),p.l-7,y(v)+4)}g.textAlign='left';g.fillText(label,p.l,17);g.textAlign='center';for(const v of (id==='forecastPlot'?[1,cut,total]:[1,Math.round(cut/2),cut]))g.fillText(v,x(v),h-23);g.fillText('Charge–discharge cycle',(p.l+w-p.r)/2,h-5);return {cv,g,w,h,p,x,y}}
function line(f,values,start,color,width=2){const {g,x,y}=f;g.strokeStyle=PC.css(color);g.lineWidth=width;g.beginPath();values.forEach((v,i)=>i?g.lineTo(x(start+i),y(v)):g.moveTo(x(start+i),y(v)));g.stroke()}
function plot(){const f=frame('forecastPlot',[1,total],[Math.min(...D.curve,...Object.values(D.predictions).flat())-.04,Math.max(...D.curve,...Object.values(D.predictions).flat())+.04],innerWidth<650?340:420,'Discharge capacity (Ah)');if(!f)return;const {g,x,y,h,w,p}=f;g.fillStyle=PC.css('--accent-soft');g.fillRect(x(cut),p.t,w-p.r-x(cut),h-p.b-p.t);g.strokeStyle=PC.css('--muted');g.setLineDash([5,4]);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x(cut),p.t);g.lineTo(x(cut),h-p.b);g.stroke();g.setLineDash([]);g.fillStyle=PC.css('--text-secondary');g.textAlign='center';g.fillText('Training only',x((1+cut)/2),29);g.fillText('Held-out comparison',x((cut+total)/2),29);line(f,D.curve.slice(0,cut+count),1,'--text-primary',2.4);line(f,D.predictions[q('model').value],cut+1,'--series-1');line(f,D.predictions[q('baseline').value],cut+1,'--series-2');const first=D.predictions[q('model').value][0];g.fillStyle=PC.css('--series-1');g.beginPath();g.arc(x(cut+1),y(first),4,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();f.cv.dataset.revealed=count;f.cv.dataset.model=q('model').value}
function update(){if(q('model').value===q('baseline').value)q('baseline').value='linear';const model=q('model').value,baseline=q('baseline').value,ratio=D.metrics[model].rmse/D.metrics[baseline].rmse;q('reveal').value=count;q('revealLabel').textContent=count?'Through cycle '+(cut+count):'Future hidden';q('modelName').textContent=names[model];q('baselineName').textContent=names[baseline];q('modelError').textContent=D.metrics[model].rmse.toFixed(3)+' Ah';q('baselineError').textContent=D.metrics[baseline].rmse.toFixed(3)+' Ah';q('firstStep').textContent=names[model]+' starts at '+D.predictions[model][0].toFixed(3)+' Ah after a last training observation of '+D.curve[cut-1].toFixed(3)+' Ah.'+(count>0?' Actual next value: '+D.predictions.truth[0].toFixed(3)+' Ah; first-step error: '+(D.predictions[model][0]-D.predictions.truth[0]).toFixed(3)+' Ah.':'');q('reading').textContent=count===0?'The forecasts are already fixed. Reveal the black measured line to see which follows the real decline.':count<n?'Revealed '+count+' of '+n+' future cycles. The forecasts stay fixed while the measured future appears.':names[model]+' has '+ratio.toFixed(2)+'× the held-out RMSE of '+names[baseline]+'. Settings were selected on cycles 89–118 before refitting the first 118 cycles.';plot()}
function stop(){cancelAnimationFrame(raf);playing=false;q('play').textContent=count===n?'Replay the reveal':'Reveal the real future';q('play').setAttribute('aria-pressed','false')}
q('play').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(playing){stop();return}if(matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){count=n;update();stop();return}if(count===n)count=0;playing=true;startCount=count;last=performance.now();q('play').textContent='Pause';q('play').setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');function tick(now){count=Math.min(n,startCount+Math.floor((now-last)/100));update();if(count<n)raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);else stop()}raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)});
q('reset').addEventListener('click',()=>{count=n;stop();update()});q('reveal').addEventListener('input',e=>{count=Number(e.target.value);stop();update()});for(const id of ['model','baseline'])q(id).addEventListener('change',update);
q('protocol').textContent=D.meta.architecture+'; train-only standardization; Adam 0.001; window 16. Raw: '+D.meta.selected.raw.mode+', '+D.meta.selected.raw.epochs+' epochs. CEEMDAN: '+D.meta.selected.ceemdan.mode+', '+D.meta.selected.ceemdan.epochs+' epochs. '+D.meta.training.caveat;PC.registerRepaint(plot);update();stop();
})();
